SEARCH
Package com.example.volt.search

Class DestinationsSearchManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.volt.search.DestinationsSearchManager
public class DestinationsSearchManager extends Object
DestinationsSearchManager is a link layer between the UI of the search mechanism and the other managers.

Representation Invariant:

  • searchView != null
  • listView != null
  • adapter != null
  • destinationSelectedCommand != null

Abstraction Function:

DestinationsSearchManager dsm represents a link between the UI of the search mechanism and the other managers such that:
  • dsm.searchView represents the SearchView that accepts queries.
  • dsm.listView represents the ListView displaying all destinations or a filtered list according to the search query.
  • dsm.adapter represents the bridge between the destination data and the listView, providing filtering and display logic.
  • dsm.destinationSelectedCommand represents the Command to execute when a Destination is selected from the list.
